title: What Norm Learns
concept: Three University of Alaska AI projects shown at a statewide symposium and reported by the Anchorage Daily News (a ski-video coach, a senior-routine sensor, a compressor digital twin) share one move: learn what is normal for one particular thing and compare the real thing to it. The film draws that move as Norm, a mint jelly that keeps the dent of whatever is pressed into him and glows red where the real thing does not fit, climbs a staircase of rising stakes, then gives the honest test a full scene: one outlet, no users, no accuracy figures, no pilots, and three things that would count as proof. Norm is a labelled metaphor.

fingerprint.palette: warm lamp-lit mustard felt, glowing rose alpenglow, lilac snow, plum window, mint jelly, signal red
fingerprint.light_story: a warm lamp pool on a golden mustard felt bench, rose alpenglow over lilac snow, a cozy amber-windowed kitchen, a plain paper test set
fingerprint.metaphor: a soft jelly that keeps the dent of whatever is pressed into it and glows red where the real thing does not fit

palette: warm lamp-lit mustard felt, glowing rose alpenglow, lilac snow, plum window, mint jelly, signal red
divergence_note: 10-17 was a bright frost noon with cyan, hazard orange and banknote green around a tall glass gauge. 10-16 a black-spruce night with tungsten and chalk. This film is a blue-hour lilac and rose world with a mustard felt workbench, a mint jelly hero and alarm red, moving through a bench, a symposium stage, a ski slope, a night kitchen, a top-down home plan, a felt staircase, a compressor yard, a pipeline, a paper test set and a ski slope.

treatment.winner: The Explainer's Norm (press, remember, press back, red where it doesn't fit), with the Dramatist's rising-stakes ladder and empty proof boxes, the Comedian's generic-advice sticky note and the Enthusiast's 2019 lineage button.
treatment.why: One physical idea makes three unlike projects legible in a glance, the honest test gets its own paper set, and the unset patch plants a question the last shot pays.

angle.thesis: Three UAA projects make the same move, learn what is normal for one particular thing and compare the real thing to it, and the stakes of getting it right climb from a ski turn to a senior's safety to a pipeline's heartbeat, while the reporting shows none of them proven yet.
supporting_facts: c1,c3: FlowLine grades a skier's own uploaded video because online feedback is generic
c5,c6: ANCHOR is designed to learn a senior's routines and alert family past a safety threshold
c7,c8,c9: a student models the compressor, the heartbeat of a proposed pipeline estimated over $54 billion
c10,c11: one first AI class in 2019 to a statewide symposium
angle.counterpoint_to_honor: These are student and faculty showcase projects, so asking for proof is early. The film credits the capacity first, then says plainly that no users, accuracy figures, pilots or deployments are reported, all from one ADN feature, and asks what would prove each.
angle.falsifiability: False if a primary source reports a pilot, accuracy figure or deployment (the 'unproven' claim expires), or if a project turns out to apply one fixed standard to everyone with no model of the particular subject.
angle.second_movement: From idea to proof. Stakes rise across the three, then the film states the stage plainly and names what would count as proof: December launch, a first household for ANCHOR, a twin checked against a real compressor. Mike Jones ethics line (through 'right now') sits at the test.
angle.valence: Earned optimism, hedged. The win is the people and direction of the work, not any proven product.

runner_up_angles.enthusiast: capacity pipeline from 2019 class to symposium (merged as the lineage beat)
runner_up_angles.skeptic: who answers when ANCHOR misses (merged as the stakes-rise question, asked not asserted)

angle.debate: Explainer thesis kept as spine. Enthusiast supplies the lineage button. Skeptic supplies the rising-stakes ladder and the unproven stage, with no failure implied.

hook.frame1: A blank mint jelly dome with a face wobbles awake on a felt bench and a hard ski boot drops and presses into his belly.
hook.headline: WHAT NORM LEARNS
hook.loopback: The last frame is Norm blank on the bench again with a boot hovering above him, the open replaying as a question.

open_loop.what: The pale unset patch on Norm's flank. Paid as the open question: what would you press him against first, since nothing is reported proven.

open_loop_2.what: Whether ANCHOR's alert has ever fired for a real household. Planted as a question mark over the button, paid as the clipboard: no pilots reported.
